verdict.rationale: Bland documents batch calls that let you start high-volume outbound campaigns by uploading recipients via CSV, so the core batch-campaign capability is first-party. Nothing in the evidence documents scheduling (a future start time or recurring schedule) or throughput controls such as concurrency or rate limits. Triggers are event-driven, not scheduled, so they do not count. Missing for 10: documented campaign scheduling, documented throughput/concurrency/rate controls, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run batch outbound call campaigns with scheduling and throughput controls

citations.quote: Batch calls let you initiate high-volume call campaigns by uploading a list of recipients via CSV.
Dispatch AI phone calls to call customers, leads, and to streamline operations.
